## Reliable Pool Cleaning From a Local Team You Can Actually Reach

SpringLake Pools & Masonry has been maintaining pools in Dallas, Pennsylvania for over a decade. We understand the unique water challenges in Luzerne County, from the hard mineral content near Harvey’s Lake that causes scale buildup to the well water conditions in Back Mountain that affect chemical balance. Our business has maintained pools throughout Dallas, Shavertown, Trucksville, and surrounding communities.

When you’re searching for “pool cleaning service near me” or “pool maintenance Dallas PA,” you want a local company with regional expertise. We’re not a large corporation from distant cities. We know which neighborhoods deal with seasonal algae blooms and which local water supplies require special chemical adjustments based on years of experience serving the Dallas area.

[Request Pool Opening Service](https://springlakepools.com/pool-cleaning-service/pool-opening-services/)

![Premier Custom Concrete Pool Builder](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/IMG_2278_Original-1024x767.jpeg)

## Pool Cleaning & Maintenance Services That Keep Water Swim-Ready

You get outcome-focused service: **clear water**, **safe chemistry**, **protected equipment**, and a pool that is **ready-to-swim** when the weather turns. Choose weekly pool maintenance, seasonal pool opening and pool closing, or a one-time cleanup when the water gets away from you.

[Pool Maintenance Service](https://springlakepools.com/pool-opening-services/)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/pool-closing-services-dallas-pa.jpg)

### Pool Opening Service

Pool opening services in Dallas typically start in April, depending on weather. We remove and store safety covers, restart all equipment, and balance water chemistry. Your pool will be swim-ready within a week.

[Pool Opening Service](https://springlakepools.com/pool-cleaning-service/pool-opening-services/)

### Pool Closing Service

Pool closing services and pool winterization protect your investment during Pennsylvania winters. We drain lines below frost level, add antifreeze where needed, and install winter covers. Proper closing prevents expensive freeze damage.

[Pool Closing Service](https://springlakepools.com/pool-closing-services/)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/pool-chemical-balancing-dallas-pa.jpg)

### Pool Chemical Balancing

Pool chemical balancing requires testing and adjusting pH, alkalinity, and sanitizer levels. Dallas has moderately hard water that affects chemical balance. We test weekly and adjust as needed.

[Pool Chemical Balancing](https://springlakepools.com/pool-chemical-balancing/)

### Pool Water Testing

Pool water testing catches problems before they become expensive. We test for bacteria, metals, and chemical levels using professional equipment. Digital test strips aren’t accurate enough for proper pool care.

[Pool Water Testing](https://springlakepools.com/pool-water-testing/)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/pool-inspection-and-compliance-services-dallas-pa.jpg)

### Pool Inspection and Safety

Pool inspection services help when buying or selling homes with pools. We check equipment function, safety features, and code compliance. Many issues are simple fixes when caught early.

[Pool Inspection and Compliance Service](https://springlakepools.com/pool-inspection-services/)

### Pool Safety Audits

Pool safety audits identify potential hazards around your pool area. We check fencing, gates, covers, and emergency equipment. Pool compliance inspections ensure commercial pools meet health department standards.

[Pool Safety Audit](https://springlakepools.com/pool-cleaning-service/pool-safety-audits/)

## Enjoy every   moment

## Service Areas Throughout Northeastern Pennsylvania

We serve [Dallas](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-dallas-pa/), [Back Mountain](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-back-mountain-pa/), Shavertown, [Bear Creek](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-bear-creek-pa/), Trucksville, [Mountain Top](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-mountain-top-pa/), and surrounding communities in Luzerne County. Our crews also work in [Clarks Summit](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-clarks-summit-pa/), [Wilkes Barre](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-wilkes-barre-pa/), Waverly, and other parts of Lackawanna County.

From Harvey’s Lake to Sweet Valley, from Tunkhannock to the Poconos ( [Tannersville](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-tannersville-pa/) and [Blakeslee](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-blakeslee-pa/)) we know the terrain, soil conditions, and local requirements. Every area has different challenges for pool construction and service.

[Learn More](https://springlakepools.com/services/)
